- Primary goal: validate 95th-percentile latency under our 1k qps synthetic workload and confirm inference cost per 1M tokens with batching.
- Secondary goal: measure output quality on our 150 prompt test set and ensure no regressions vs. our existing in-house model.
- Timeline: ideally a two-week hands-on trial starting 7/13, with a mid-trial check on day 7 and an internal review by 7/27.

Liam — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming next steps from Redwood's side and attaching a first-draft success criteria spreadsheet for your review. High level plan below:

1) Success criteria (attached):
   - Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms on 1k qps synthetic, with target tail < 500ms under burst.
   - Cost: baseline estimate for 1M tokens with continuous batching; we'll provide low/med/high configs.
   - Quality: pass >= 88% on your 150-prompt test set (precision-style metric in the sheet).
   - Reliability: zero crashes, model fallback behavior for overloaded conditions.

2) Evaluation plan:
   - Week 0 (prep): network allowlist, access to test harness, config file exchange.
   - Week 1 (7/13-7/19): initial run, latency/cost profiling, and quick quality pass.
   - Midpoint sync: 7/16 — 30-minute readout with infra and CS.
   - Week 2 (7/20-7/26): follow-up runs, resolve perf regressions, final quality report.

3) Ownership:
   - Redwood POC lead: Nikhil Sharma (me) — trial orchestration, perf configs, billing ops.
   - Redwood CS: Evelyn Hart — onboarding, logs, and output-quality evaluation support.
   - ClearBay lead: Liam O'Neill — test suite, internal approval.

4) Deliverables before trial start: signed NDA/PO, shared Drive access to the harness, network checklist completed.

I've attached: POC_Success_Criteria_v1.xlsx and a short network-requirements.pdf. Also linking a short eval script we run internally (Drive link below).

If this looks good, I'll send a one-page mutual action plan and calendar invites for the 7/13 start and the 7/16 midpoint.

Best,
